## What this changes

Say what changed and why, in a few sentences.

## How you checked it

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:archive` passes against an archive built from the original 0.2.1-rc.5 (needed for a change to a patch, a rule, or a scan)
- [ ] `npm run scan` reports no findings

## Safety

- [ ] The change adds no original app archive, no installed-app file, and no binary built from them
- [ ] The change adds no personal data: no names, e-mail addresses, home paths, machine names, keys or tokens
- [ ] A new or changed build patch counts the places it changed and stops on a wrong count

## Documents

- [ ] I updated the wiki page that describes this, and its "Status" line
